caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic jug in the form of a standing human figure, rendered in shades of brown with a glossy finish that reflects light in various places on its surface. The figure is dressed in period attire, including a long coat with buttons, breeches, and a large tricorn hat that forms the open top of the jug. The facial features are detailed, showing a prominent nose, lips, and chin; the hair is styled in long, side-swept sections. The handle extends from the back of the hat down to the lower back of the figure. The figure's arms are bent at the elbows, with one hand resting at its side and the other near the front. The jug stands on a wide base that resembles the folds of a garment at the feet of the figure. The background is an even, light beige color with no other objects present.
title: Ceramic Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
